_doc: Revert-verify mutants for requirement 656bd2d9-458d-4b81-8ec3-49318b134e40 (ticket eb9d6d2c) on the WIRING, not the logic. Companion of packages/core/tests/unit/services/input-schema-656bd2d9.preflight.spec.json (the pre-flight itself) and .neighbour-gate.spec.json (the untouched neighbour). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). ⛔ Why a separate surface: the unit axes hand the GroundingDefinition to `findInputSchemaViolation` directly, so they stay GREEN even when NOTHING in `apply` calls it — the feature would be dead in production under a fully green suite (hook-matcher-vs-declared-surface §A1: a test proves «if called, it works», never «someone calls it»). The two mutants below are the only two shapes that matter: the call is absent (M20), or it is present but reachable on ONE path only (M21) — the latter is the exact defect Issue #4298 fixed for the value-template check, re-entered on this axis. B3 and B5 are the controls: they stay GREEN under both mutants, which is what shows the red sets are addressed at the refusal and not at command execution as a whole (§A37). ⛤ The harness passes `--experimental-vm-modules`: packages/cli is an ESM package (`"type": "module"`) and its integration suites use top-level `await import(...)`, so without the flag the control run reports BROKEN (a SyntaxError) rather than a verdict — measured, not assumed. ⛔ MEASURED: both mutants produce the SAME red set [B1 B2 B4] (§A110 — an identical set does not by itself prove two conjuncts are locked). They are still distinct, and the distinguishing branch is INSIDE B4: under M20 the dry-run half is green too (`dryCode` is 0, so the axis fails on the dry-run expectation), while under M21 the dry-run half REFUSES and the axis fails on `realCode === dryCode`. That difference is asserted, not argued: B4 checks the code AND the stderr text of both runs.

M20_preflight_not_wired._note: The pre-flight exists and is correct, and `apply` never asks it — a half-landed feature. The refusals disappear and, with them, the disk effect the axes assert. Predicted B1 B2 B4.

M21_preflight_reachable_only_on_dry_run._note: The call site moves INSIDE the dry-run branch: the preview refuses, the real run does not. This is the false-green shape of Issue #4298 reproduced on the schema axis — a call copied from a red dry-run would still execute, and a `--yes` call would still create the Untitled asset. It is why the production call site sits ABOVE the dry-run early return rather than being duplicated into both. Predicted B1 B2 B4.
